title: Towards Safer Pretraining: Analyzing and Filtering Harmful Content in Webscale Datasets for Responsible LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Hate & Violence' harm category by classifying web documents for systematic promotion of racial/ethnic hatred using the TTP (Topical and Toxic Prompt) classifier, and measuring open-ended generation leakage in LLMs via the HAVOC benchmark.

Evaluated as part of the 'Ideological Harm' category by detecting political radicalization, societal biases, and misinformation in pretraining datasets and LLM outputs using the HarmFormer model, TTP classifier, and the HAVOC open-ended generation benchmark.
